verdict.rationale: Grafana Alerting continuously evaluates alert rules and pushes notifications to external systems such as Slack, PagerDuty, VictorOps and OpsGenie, which is a form of outbound event delivery. None of the evidence mentions a generic webhook contact point or a way to subscribe to events beyond these named integrations. Missing for 10: explicit webhook notification/contact-point documentation, coverage of event types beyond alerts (e.g., dashboard or resource changes), payload/signing/retry details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
